snippet.title: GAMEPLAY TRAILER - “Dorman’s Attraction: Upgraded and Advanced” GAMEPLAY TRAILER - MARCH 21ST, 2025
snippet.description:
The NEW trailer for Dorman’s Attraction: Upgraded and Advanced!
Official release date is set for March 21st, 2025!

*Pre-order the game for $6.99 here!
https://frexcellor.itch.io/dormans-attraction
*The demo is also free to play on itch.io!
https://frexcellor.itch.io/dormans-attraction-demo

Thanks to my friend as well for helping with the female voice acting!

Story: You are Eric, a new nightguard working at Dorman's Attraction. However, the entire establishment seems off, the scent of your father's work reeked all over the place. Also, the animatronics are trying to attack you!?

Can you make it through all fifteen nights, surviving twelve (or thirteen) different animatronics? Can u beat all of the six minigames? Can you collect all of the collectables? And can you finally uncover the dark secrets that are buried deep within the walls? Or will you die trying?  Dorman's Attraction is the real nightmare!

*This game contains some visuals and sounds that may be too much for sensitive viewers. Play or watch with caution.
This game contains the following features: Office Nights (1-15),  platformer finale along with ending cutscene, 6 minigames, 10 collectables for more lore, 5 audio tapes, and descriptions of each character! (As well as secrets cheat codes...shh)

This game is an indie project by Frexcellor or Zayah, which ever is good, and I've been working on this project for about two years. Mind you, I did take a break which led to it taking so long, but I'm back with more motivation than ever and a lot of my passion for game developing was put into this game. I've made a ton of other games, but they were not as nearly close to how big this game is.
Dorman & Friends' Diner is a game series I started in 2021 using scratch. Throughout the next several years, I made five more games (Dorman & Friends' Animated Diner; Dorman & Friends' Abandoned Diner; Dorman & Friends' Open Park; Dorman & Friends' Nightmare; Dorman & Friends' Diner: Before Action). The series also goes behind the name D.F.D. or DFD.
Who knows, after this game there might be another one 👀

GAME RELEASING MARCH 21st, 2025! GET READY!
